headline: Order sets up a group of federal agencies to work on issues involving US territories, known as insular areas.
what_it_does: This executive order creates an Interagency Group on Insular Areas. Based on the title, the group brings together several federal agencies to coordinate how the government handles matters involving US territories such as Puerto Rico, Guam, the US Virgin Islands, American Samoa, and the Northern Mariana Islands. No summary was provided, so the group's exact duties, membership, and powers are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Federal policies and programs that reach these areas may be coordinated through the new interagency group.
Participating agencies are expected to work together through the group on territory-related issues.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely 2003-05-12, the date it was signed; no separate date was provided.
